Tyrosine Kinase 2 (19p13.2): TYK2 mediates type I IFN signaling. TYK2 inhibition being explored for SS.
Toll-Like Receptor 7 (Xp22.2): TLR7 is directly targeted by HCQ in SS. TLR7 sensing of Ro/SSA-RNA in pDCs drives IFN-α.
Toll-Like Receptor 9 (3p21.2): TLR9 senses CpG DNA; HCQ inhibits TLR9 activation reducing autoantibody production.
Myeloid Differentiation Primary Response 88 (3p22.2): Universal TLR adaptor driving IFN-α in salivary gland pDCs.
IFN Alpha/Beta Receptor 1 (21q22.11): Anifrolumab target. Mediates type I IFN signaling in SS salivary glands.
Interferon Alpha 1 (9p21.3): IFN-α massively produced by pDCs in SS. Correlates with disease activity.
Interleukin-6 (7p15.3): Elevated in SS serum/saliva. Promotes Th17/Tfh differentiation.
CD40 Ligand (Xq26.3): CD40L overexpressed on SS T cells. Drives germinal center B cell responses.
Forkhead Box P3 (Xp11.23): Treg dysfunction documented in SS. Low-dose IL-2 therapy being explored.
CD19 Molecule (16p11.2): Pan-B cell marker targeted by CAR-T. Being explored for severe SS.
Activation-Induced Cytidine Deaminase (12p13.31): AID highly expressed in SS GC B cells. Links to lymphoma risk.
